[19] The effect of FAST solid-state joining on interface microstructure and bonding strengths of dissimilar Ni-based superalloys remains to be studied.
Unlike conventional diffusion bonding, heating is directly applied during FAST solid-state joining via electric current flow through the material, leading to rapid Joule heating.

The shorter processing times enabled in the FAST process can be attributed to either the enhanced diffusion from the application of electric current or the more rapid and homogenous temperature rise from the resulting Joule heating.
